author: youngwan-kim
body:
## PR description

This PR adds `TauTriggerValidator`, a DQM module in `Validation/RecoTau` that measures the efficiency of the Phase-2 tau HLT paths against a generator level denominator. `HLTGenValSource` fills its denominator object by object, so for a cross trigger it cannot require all legs in the same event. This module selects the gen objects a path requires in each event, and the event enters the denominator only if every leg is found. 

Related presentations : 

- [Tau Trigger meeting (5 Oct)](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1731654/#5-roundtable)
- [Tau POG meeting (9 Nov)](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1749979/#6-tau-paths-validation-tool-up)

Each selected event is then checked : 
- path progress, from `TriggerResults`: Gen, Gen+L1 (the path ran past its L1 seed module) and Gen+L1+HLT (the path accepted the event);
- object matching, from `hltTriggerSummaryAOD`: each leg is matched to the trigger objects of the filter named in its configuration. `_matched` requires every leg to match. Events where no leg, or exactly one leg, matches are filled in separate histograms, so an inefficiency can be attributed to a leg.

The difference between `_hlt` and `_matched` shows how often the path fired on objects other than the selected gen legs.

The configuration (`Validation/RecoTau/python/hltTauTriggerValidation_cff.py`) has one module per path. The gen pT cut of each leg and the tau eta cut are parsed from the path name, and a value set explicitly on a leg takes precedence. The paths currently included, all in `HLT_75e33`:
- `HLT_DoubleMediumDeepTauPFTauHPS35_eta2p1`
- `HLT_DoubleMediumChargedIsoPFTauHPS40_eta2p1`
- `HLT_IsoMu20_eta2p1_LooseDeepTauPFTauHPS27_eta2p1_CrossL1`
- `HLT_Ele30_WPTight_L1Seeded_LooseDeepTauPFTauHPS30_eta2p1_CrossL1`
- `HLT_LooseDeepTauPFTauHPS150_L1NN_eta2p1`

The histograms are written to `HLT/Tau/Validation/<path>`. The harvesting (`Validation/RecoTau/python/hltTauTriggerPostProcessor_cff.py`, `DQMGenericClient`) computes `Eff_L1`, `Eff_HLT`, `Eff_HLTgivenL1` and `Eff_Matched` vs pT, eta and phi, and the `Frac_NoMatch` / `Frac_Leg<N><Obj>Only` breakdown.

Developers : @Chihwan-An , @kkimeun , @youngwan-kim 
Also tagging Tau trigger L3s : @elenavernazza and @fibilandz

## PR validation:

To run it (the input needs `TriggerResults` and `hltTriggerSummaryAOD` from a Phase-2 HLT step with process name `HLT`, plus `genParticles`):

```bash
cmsrel CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3
cd CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3/src
cmsenv
git cms-init
git cms-merge-topic youngwan-kim:TauHLTValTool_CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3
scram b -j 8

# HLTGenValSource + TauTriggerValidator
cmsRun Validation/HLTrigger/test/runPhaseIIValSource_cfg.py \
    inputFiles=file:<input_with_HLT>.root \
    outputFile=hltValidation.root

# harvesting
cmsRun Validation/HLTrigger/test/runValClient_cfg.py \
    inputFiles=file:hltValidation.root \
    outTag=TauHLT
```

With [ZpTT RelVal samples](https://cmsweb.cern.ch/das/request?input=dataset%3D%2FRelValZpTT_1500_14%2FCMSSW_20_1_0_pre3-PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D128_RegeneratedGS_PU_20260903_192421_RV19-v1%2FGEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW&instance=prod/global) Eunsu (@kkimeun) tested a release validation campaign between `20_1_0_pre3` and `20_1_0_pre2`, with the results linked [here](https://eunsu.web.cern.ch/TauHLTValidation/pre3_D128_vs_pre2_D121/plots/ZpTT/index.html).
